info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Status API allows organizations to retrieve the current statuses of job applications submitted through their careers portal. Users can query the status of multiple applications in a single request, making it easier to track progress and manage applicant communications. This API is particularly useful for HR departments and recruitment teams who need to efficiently monitor applicant statuses and provide timely updates to candidates. It streamlines the application tracking process, improving overall operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current status of all applications. It provides insights into whether the applications are active, inactive, or in a pending state.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of applications. This request expects a JSON payload that conforms to the specified schema. Ensure that the structure and required fields in the body are accurate to get a proper response.

200.description: Success: The application status has been retrieved successfully.
